message:
fix: fix commit storage paths and git configuration logic

WHY
Commit storage was disconnected from the git repository structure, and incorrect documentation paths caused confusion. Additionally, the configuration logic was overwriting existing fetch refspecs instead of appending them, preventing multiple refspecs.

WHAT
* Relocated commit persistence path to the .git/git-courer/ subdirectory.
* Corrected misleading comments and documentation regarding the metadata directory path.
* Switched to using git config --add for remote.origin.fetch to support multi-valued configuration keys.
author: Alejandro
